We work alongside academics, faculties and partner hospitals to protect and commercialise innovations through creating spinout companies , licensing and Social Ventures - always in ways that respect academic values and ambition.
Our portfolio now spans advanced therapeutics, digital health, quantum software and climate technologies to next-generation AI.
Learn about what we do Our guiding values Impact-driven We prioritise meaningful benefits: patient/user outcomes, societal value, sustainability and economic growth.
Collaborative We work side-by-side with UCL researchers and professional services, building long-term partnerships with industry, investors and healthcare providers.

Breadcrumb trail Home About us What we do UCL Ventures enables and empowers UCL’s forward-thinking academics and clinicians to turn new knowledge and bold concepts into commercial successes.
Our multidisciplinary team and board bring insight across science, engineering, health, data and impact‑led innovation.
Our work spans sectors from gene therapies to AI, clean energy and quantum.
Impact Report Proven impact - locally and globally Over many years, we have supported a significant portfolio of spinouts, licences and social ventures, helping research move from insight to impact.
University College London was established in 1826 with a new vision: to make higher education accessible to all.
As London’s first university, UCL challenged convention by admitting students regardless of faith, introducing practical subjects, and later granting women access to higher education alongside men.
We have a separate Board, comprising experts who have built successful businesses themselves and understand the worlds of venture capital and academia.
